messages:
Sam (marketing): Hey @eng-runtime — we need a compact reproducible pack for the Tuesday webinar panel demo. Can you produce: quantized-int8 and fp16 runs, embed + gen latencies, coldstart vs warmup profiles, and a short runbook by EOD Monday? :pray:

bench-bot: queued job #4821 — collecting baseline traces for model: redwood-7b-v2 (staging)

Priya (eng-runtime): Sam — can do. Two quick clarifications: 1) target sample length distribution? 2) do you want p50/p95/p99 and also per-shard breakdowns?

Sam (marketing): Short->mid (16-256 tokens) mostly, include a few long-context >1024 edge cases. We want p50/p95/p99 + coldstart heatmap. For embeddings, p50 and p90 is fine. Also: include a 10% blind holdback set for validation.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Also need the exact demo prompts/payloads. Drop them in the drive or a gist. Do you want quantized runs with KV-cache warmed or strictly cold?

Sam (marketing): I uploaded a pack: https://drive.redwood/demo-pack-2026. Include both: cold (no warmup) and warm (pre-warm with 5 synthetic requests). Quantized variant = int8 fast-kernel and fp16 baseline.

Priya (eng-runtime): Got the drive. We'll run on dedicated staging nodes. Expected deliverables: CSV with per-request latencies (setup, model, total), token counts, model_variant, warmup_flag; traces tar.gz; aggregated summary CSV; short runbook with commands. ETA: Monday EOD. Any compliance flags?

Sam (marketing): All synthetic/anonymized, no PII.

Anita (eng-runtime-lead): Quick governance note — marketing must not cherry-pick top-performing samples for public claims. Please keep a 10% random holdback and share the manifest so SRE can validate.

Sam (marketing): Added holdback cohort to the drive, flagged in manifest.csv.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Running a quick smoke now. We'll test batch sizes [1,2,4] and prefix caching on/off. If we see high variance we'll do a rerun with adjusted batch windows.

bench-bot: job#4821 -> ingest complete, 48 payloads found, artifacts: /artifacts/4821, status: queued-for-runs

Priya (eng-runtime): Note: int8 uses fast-kernel v3 on this model which reduces variance. For warm runs we'll use warmup=5 (synthetic requests). We'll include the exact invocation in README.

Sam (marketing): Can the final summary highlight two demo-friendly KPIs: median generation < 250ms for short prompts and embedding latency < 30ms? Flag pass/fail against those thresholds.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Will include KPI flags in the aggregated summary table.

Sam (marketing): Example small snippet of the run command you'd publish in the runbook (feel free to edit):

```bash
# run warm quantized test
bench-tool run --model redwood-7b-v2 --variant int8 --batch 1 --warmup 5 --payloads /artifacts/4821/payloads.jsonl --out /artifacts/4821/runs/warm_int8.csv
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Thanks — we'll push artifacts to the drive path and post a short verification checklist when done.

Carlos (eng-runtime): Smoke run complete, initial numbers look reasonable. Posting a tiny sample of the per-request CSV:

```
request_id,model_variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
r1,fp16,false,412,395,48
r2,int8,true,198,185,32
r3,fp16,false,1350,1330,1200
```

Sam (marketing): Perfect. We'll wait for the full artifacts and the runbook. Thanks everyone — will update the webinar slides once we have the verified summary. :thumbsup:
